Payment Processing Exception.name: Payment Processing Exception
Payment Processing Exception.description: Manual exception marker for a booking that must not proceed through the normal payment path until resolved.

Published Price per Student (IDR).name: Published Price per Student (IDR)
Published Price per Student (IDR).description: Published joinable-product price commitment per student. This is not a payment field.

Database Group.name: Database Group
Database Group.description: Functional group classification from Source Databases page

Creation Check.name: Creation Check
Creation Check.description: Presence check for expected downstream records. 🟢 = all expected records are present (Pattern A: Sale + Hourly Rate; Pattern B: Hourly Rate), or Promo with no Sale/Hourly Rate. 🟡 = partial Pattern A. 🔴 = expected records missing, or a Promo has a Sale/Hourly Rate. Blank = not Confirmed.

formula.expression:
lets(
  hasSale, prop("Sales").length() > 0,
  hasHR, prop("Hourly Rate").length() > 0,
  isPatternA, prop("Event Type") == "Private Lesson" or prop("Event Type") == "Match with Coach",
  isPromo, prop("Event Type") == "Promo",
  ifs(
    prop("Status") != "Confirmed", "",
    isPromo, if(hasSale or hasHR, "🔴", "🟢"),
    isPatternA and hasSale and hasHR, "🟢",
    isPatternA and (hasSale or hasHR), "🟡",
    isPatternA, "🔴",
    hasHR, "🟢",
    "🔴"
  )
)

Event Type.name: Event Type
Event Type.description: Derives Event Type from Areas, with Clinic Format taking priority. Marketing maps to Promo when Clinic Format is empty. Existing Area mappings remain unchanged.

formula.expression:
lets(
  /* Get area names from the Areas relation */
  areaNames, {{notion:block_property:elAV:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:728afdfb-c3c7-816d-b8e3-0003a3b6442c}}.map(current.{{notion:block_property:title:261afdfb-c3c7-81b5-94ae-000b701183cd:728afdfb-c3c7-816d-b8e3-0003a3b6442c}}),

  /* Clinic Format keeps priority; Marketing maps to Promo when it is empty */
  ifs(
    not empty({{notion:block_property:zVwB:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:728afdfb-c3c7-816d-b8e3-0003a3b6442c}}), {{notion:block_property:zVwB:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:728afdfb-c3c7-816d-b8e3-0003a3b6442c}},
    areaNames.includes("Marketing"), "Promo",
    areaNames.includes("Private Lessons"), "Private Lesson",
    areaNames.includes("Clinics"), "Clinic",
    areaNames.includes("Match with Coach"), "Match with Coach",
    areaNames.includes("Play with Coach"), "Play with Coach",
    areaNames.includes("Player Academy"), "Player Academy",
    areaNames.includes("Coaches Academy"), "Coaches Academy",
    areaNames.includes("Overseas Clubs"), "Private Lesson",
    ""
  )
)

Cancelled By....name: Cancelled By...
Cancelled By....description: Who initiated the cancellation. Student = customer cancelled. Tacit = Tacit cancelled (e.g. coach sick, below minimum). Club = the club/venue cancelled the session. Aligned with TP: Sales "Cancelled By" options 16 Jul 2026.
